title: A trapped mainnet call whose diagnostic events carry the contract's own error code
pattern: The contract fails with its own error (SCError type contract, code 2006). The result only says trapped; the code lives in the diagnostic events SDF's lake keeps. Readers that decode SCError as a fixed set of host error types, or that only read the result, lose the contract's reason.

hazards.placement: SCError.SCE_CONTRACT: the contract's own error code 2006 in the diagnostic events of a trapped call

facts.says: A diagnostic event carries contract error 2006.
